landing.hero_sub: MotionMeet helps you log workouts, track progress, and stay motivated with friends — all in one place.
landing.social_label: Loved by athletes across the globe
landing.feature1_desc: Intuitive workout logging that gets out of your way. Track sets, reps and weights in seconds.
landing.feature2_desc: Advanced charts and personal records show exactly how far you've come.
landing.feature3_desc: Share workouts, challenge your crew and stay motivated together.
landing.showcase_title: Everything you need to build your best body
landing.testimonial1_text: MotionMeet completely changed how I train. The PR tracking and progress charts are incredible.
landing.testimonial2_text: Finally an app that doesn't get in the way. Simple, fast, and it keeps me accountable.
landing.testimonial3_text: I recommend MotionMeet to all my clients. The routine builder is a game changer.
landing.cta_title: Ready to start your fitness journey?
landing.cta_sub: Join 50,000+ athletes already using MotionMeet — it's completely free.
landing.description: MotionMeet is a free workout tracker for iOS and Android. Build routines and track progress with friends.

features_page.hero_title: Everything You Need to Train Smarter
features_page.hero_sub: From workout logging to social challenges — MotionMeet is built for serious athletes.
features_page.f1_desc: Log any exercise in seconds. Track sets, reps, weight, and notes — exactly the way you train.
features_page.f2_desc: Visualize your gains over time with beautiful charts and automatic personal record detection.
features_page.f3_desc: Build powerful training routines and start them with a single tap. Organize with folders.
features_page.f4_desc: Share your workouts, celebrate PRs, and stay accountable with your training crew.
features_page.f5_desc: A searchable exercise library with muscle-group filters and localized guidance where available.
features_page.f6_desc: Weekly and monthly analytics that show your training volume, frequency, and trends.

pricing_page.hero_sub: Start free and upgrade when you're ready. No hidden fees.
pricing_page.pro_desc: For dedicated athletes who want the full experience.
pricing_page.faq1_q: Can I change my plan later?
pricing_page.faq1_a: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade at any time. Changes take effect immediately.
pricing_page.faq2_q: Is there a free trial for Pro?
pricing_page.faq2_a: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial for all Pro and Elite plans — no credit card required.
pricing_page.faq3_q: What payment methods do you accept?
pricing_page.faq3_a: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and Apple Pay / Google Pay.
pricing_page.faq4_q: Do I lose my data if I downgrade?
pricing_page.faq4_a: No! Your workout history is always preserved regardless of your plan.
pricing_page.cta_title: Still not sure? Try Pro free for 14 days.

about_page.hero_sub: We're building the most intuitive workout tracker to help you focus on what matters: your progress.
about_page.story_p1: MotionMeet started in 2023 with a simple frustration: fitness apps were too complicated. They were cluttered with ads, social feeds, and features we didn't need.
about_page.story_p2: We wanted a digital gym partner. Something that gets out of your way when you're lifting, but gives you powerful insights when you're resting.
about_page.story_quote: The best workout app is the one you actually use. We designed MotionMeet to be that app.
about_page.story_p3: MotionMeet brings workout logging, personal records and controlled social sharing into one focused experience.
about_page.team1_bio: Ex-Google engineer. Obsessed with clean UI.
about_page.team2_bio: Mom of 3, fitness nerd keeping our features sensible.
about_page.team3_bio: Building the infrastructure that keeps your data safe.
about_page.val1_desc: Logging a set should take seconds, not minutes.
about_page.val2_desc: Your health data is yours, always.
about_page.val3_desc: We build what our users actually ask for.
about_page.cta_sub: Join the community and take your training to the next level.

support.faq1_q: Where are my workout data stored?
support.faq1_a: All your data is stored encrypted securely on our cloud servers.
support.faq2_q: How can I reset my password?
support.faq2_a: Contact us at support@motionmeet.app for password reset assistance.
support.faq3_a: Yes. You can export your data from the Privacy and Data section in Settings.
support.faq4_q: Which platforms does the app support?
support.faq4_a: MotionMeet is available on iOS, Android, and Web.
support.faq5_q: I'm not receiving notifications, what should I do?
support.faq5_a: Make sure notifications are enabled in Settings > Notifications and check your device permission settings.

location.use_current_hint: Suggests a city. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

location.no_results_body: Try the city name, or the province it belongs to.

location.load_failed: Location settings could not be loaded.
location.permission_denied: Location permission is needed to detect your city. You can also search for it instead.

location.privacy_footer_web: MotionMeet reads your position only while the Nearby page is open, never in the background, and keeps no history of where you have been. Place data by Countries States Cities Database · ODbL v1.0.

nearby.description: Athletes training close to you, shown as distance ranges only.
nearby.settings_hint: Find athletes training close to you

nearby.visible_hint: Turn this off to keep browsing without being listed by others.
nearby.distance_visibility_hint: Distances are always ranges. An exact figure is never shown to anyone.
nearby.delete_hint: Erases the saved position and switches the feature off.
nearby.delete_body: Your saved position and nearby preferences are erased and the feature is switched off. Your profile location is not affected.
nearby.deleted_body: Nothing about your position is stored any more.
nearby.off_body: Turn it on to see athletes training close to you.
nearby.no_fix_web_body: Refresh to read your position and load the list.
nearby.stale_title: Your position is out of date
nearby.empty_body: Try a wider radius — MotionMeet is still growing in your area.
nearby.denied_body: Nearby needs your location while the page is open. You can allow it any time.
nearby.blocked_web_body: Your browser is blocking location for MotionMeet. Allow it from the padlock icon in the address bar, then try again.
nearby.insecure_body: Browsers only share your position over https. Open MotionMeet on its secure address to use Nearby.
nearby.unavailable_body: Your position could not be read. Please try again in a moment.
nearby.timeout_body: Reading your position took too long. Please try again.
nearby.privacy_note: Distances are shown as ranges, never as an exact figure. MotionMeet does not track you in the background and keeps no location history.
